body:
Good morning!

I need flour for Monday's bread. Would you please meet me at the mill by the river? There is grain to clean, and flour to weigh.

Look for the big water wheel.
summary: Help Mr. Tobias make flour at the mill.
done: The flour is ready for Monday's bread, and the table is set. Well done!

tasks.text: Make flour with Mr. Tobias at the mill
Stroke the horse beside the mill
